convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicators (Trading Channel Index) which are not built-in MT5 indicators. Requires understanding of the custom indicator's internal calculation to replicate in Python. Otherwise standard entry/exit logic.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative input=fixed lots, positive input=fraction of deposit

custom_logic_notes: Uses iCustom to call 'Trading_Channel_Index' indicator with configurable period. The TCI is a channel-based oscillator similar to CCI; crossover of TCI above its signal MA triggers long, crossunder triggers short. Signal reversal closes existing opposite positions before opening new ones. Lot size input is dual-purpose: negative values treated as fixed lots, positive values as fraction of free margin.
python_conversion_notes: The Trading Channel Index custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. It appears to be a variant of the Commodity Channel Index (CCI) with a moving average signal line. The CCI calculation uses Typical Price, SMA of Typical Price, and Mean Deviation. If TCI is standard CCI, use pandas_ta.ti.cci or manual implementation. Entry/exit and position sizing logic is straightforward to convert. Ensure the conditional lot sizing (negative=fixed, positive=fraction) is faithfully replicated.
